newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan residential fire kills five.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan residential fire kills five.

text.p: A fire raged through two residential buildings in northern Taipei early on Saturday, killing five people, Taiwan police said.
The blaze began on the first floor of one of the buildings and quickly spread to the two upper floors, then jumped to the adjacent structure, officials said.
"The wooden material of the two buildings meant that the fire spread very quickly," one fire official said.
It took firefighters several hours to extinguish the blaze, officials said. The victims were all dead when firefighters found them.
The cause of the fire has not been determined.
